subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` check threshold that lets operator gates ignore lower-severity secrets-audit findings?
rationale: The code path is narrow and tested, but deciding whether info-level secrets-audit findings may be ignored by automation is a security/product policy choice for the secrets audit surface.

options.title: Sponsor current threshold
options.body: Accept the opt-in public CLI contract because the default remains `info` and the PR includes docs, tests, CI, and redacted terminal proof.

options.title: Request narrower policy
options.body: Ask for a smaller owner-approved gate, such as limiting the threshold to specific finding classes or folding it into a broader audit policy design.

options.title: Close for now
options.body: Decline the public threshold until a maintainer/secops owner decides that secrets-audit gates should support this policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor current threshold
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in public CLI contract because the default remains `info` and the PR includes docs, tests, CI, and redacted terminal proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh has the strongest feature-history connection to the secrets audit flow and is listed for Core, CLI, Gateway, Security, and Agents.
